Dinosaur Origin

Everything Venus members need for the 91-day Jurassic season, in one place: what to build, what to farm, when each event runs, where to spend, and the mistakes that sink a season. Read Start and Week 1 before the season opens; come back to the rest as each system unlocks. Then take the quiz at the bottom.

If you read nothing else

Your first week decides your last week. Season 3 runs on compounding loops, and every day you fall behind stays behind.

Virus resistance is income #1

The Biotech Lab sets the highest dinosaur level you can hit. Higher dinos pay more glory, badges, scales and chest loot. A slow Lab means low-tier farming, which means fewer scales, which means a slower Lab.

Greenhouses on day one #2

Build all four Bio Greenhouses immediately. A greenhouse built on day four has lost three days of Fern Leaves forever.

Support spec first #3

Faster building, more resources from kills, extra virus resistance. Switch to Combat later, once Lv.60 dinos are easy.

Stegosaurus before Raptors #4

Attempts are capped, not fuel. Stego drops Ancient Dino Eggs; Raptors don't. Spend capped attempts on Stego first.

Bank your diamonds #5

Trade Hubs run on diamonds and are the best diamond-to-power shop all season. Don't spend diamonds on anything else before they open.

Never miss Sunday 12:00 #6

The Ancient Dino world boss dies in about 5–15 minutes on an active server. Alarm at 11:55 Apocalypse Time.

01

Season overview

If you played Season 2 (Everfrost), you already know about 70% of this. Same loop, new skin, a few new systems.

The core loop: kill map creatures → bank seasonal resources → feed them into the resistance building → unlock higher-level creatures → repeat. Everything else in the season hangs off this loop.

Season 3Season 2 equivalent

What's genuinely new

  • Hatch of Legends — raise one dinosaur companion all season for a troop attack bonus that lasts until season end.
  • Trade Hubs — capturable alliance structures that print diamonds, contested three times a week.
  • Fossil Album — a 20-slot collection fed by the Sunday world boss.
  • Hero Level Swap — move levels and skill investment from an old hero onto a new one.
  • Combat spec: +1 Fortification — Season 2's Combat path gave an extra Armory; this season it adds an extra Fortification.
The F2P warningSeason 3 is noticeably harder for free-to-play players than Season 2, and the reason is Trade Hubs: they run entirely on diamonds. Spend your diamond stock in the two weeks before the season and you'll be watching the best shop in the game from outside. Bank them.

Seasonal buildings & the four resources

All seasonal buildings use Fern Leaves and Cretaceous Scales, and they only exist for this season.

OrderBuildingPriorityWhat it does
1Biotech LabCriticalRaises virus resistance = the max dino level you can attack. Everything scales from this. Once Lv.60 dinos are comfortable, upgrades stop being mandatory and you can diversify.
2Bio GreenhouseCriticalPassive Fern Leaves. 4 plots by default, a 5th with Wartime Investment. Build all four at once and keep them upgraded.
3Alliance Centers ×3HighTerritory, borders, Glory War. Position matters more than level in week one. Placed by leadership (R5/R4).
4Command CenterMediumSeasonal troop damage. Strong but not urgent; start after Lab and Greenhouses are stable.
5Armory ×2 & Fortification ×2MediumTroop attack and defense. Upgrade them in step. This season, Combat specialization adds a 3rd Fortification, not a 3rd Armory.
Alliance Center rules (in-game)
  • Every season building needs an Alliance Center nearby, so these come first.
  • Only the Leader and R4s can place them. Max 3 per alliance, each on a different tile level.
  • Garrison troops in them to speed up construction — Venus members, please help when asked.
  • Recalling a center empties its durability; it has to be paid for again to re-place.

Can't solo high tiers? Join ralliesJoining a stronger player's rally gives you the same glory as leading it. No penalty. An unused attempt is worth nothing, so always attack the highest level your resistance allows — the reward curve is steep.

Eggs are flat at 150 at every level, while Ferns and Scales climb steeply. Farming for eggs only? The lowest tier you clear reliably is enough. Farming for building materials? Push as high as your power allows.

Glory Points & Glory Chests

Every kill pays glory scaled to the target's level. A Glory Chest is ready every 8 hours, so 3 per day. Miss one and you lose a third of that day's badges.

Glory rank pays nothing directlyThere's no leaderboard reward for personal glory rank. Glory matters because it builds badges and feeds Venus's alliance season points. Aim for speed (earn early, let it compound), not placement.

Hero Level Swap

Levels always swap

Hero levels are fully exchanged between the two heroes.

Skills are optional

Toggle each skill on or off. Skills only move between matching slots (1↔1, 2↔2).

Same quality for skills

Different hero qualities swap levels only, not skill levels.

Star cap

If the receiver's star level can't hold a skill level, it caps. The in-game rules say excess skill books are not refunded.

Skill locking

If a hero drops below a skill's unlock level, that skill locks until you level back up.

Timing

Swap around events and PvP windows, never mid-war. One Level Swapper per swap.

ExampleLv.150 legacy hero (skills maxed) ⇄ Lv.1 new meta hero → the new hero becomes Lv.150 with skills carried (same quality), the old one drops to Lv.1. Check quality, stars and skill unlock levels first.
07

Specialization (Lv.50 cap)

The cap stays at Lv.50 this season; Lv.70 opens in Season 4. Below Lv.30 you're Support by default; from Lv.30 you choose.

Start in Support — this isn't closeSupport gives build speed, more resources per kill and extra virus resistance: the three levers that compound in weeks 1–4. Switch to Combat once your Lab clears Lv.60 dinos comfortably and Greenhouses are stable, usually mid-season. War players switch then; economy players can stay Support all season.

Extra building from Combat specialization

SeasonCombat bonus

There are no Lv.51–70 talents this season. Guides that list them are written for servers where Dinosaur Origin is Season 4.

The Season 03 tab

Season Points, Season Journey, Wartime Investment, Level Swap and Bones & Eggs Boom all live here.

Alliance season points

Venus's score = every member's Personal Glory + points from captured cities. Journey targets, boss damage, Trade Hub holds and Clash for Glory results all feed it.

  • Cities earn points over time while held.
  • Losing a city does not remove points already banked. Holding one for a day is permanently worth something.
  • Glory War winners take 20% of the loser's Season Points.

Season Journey

A season-long EXP track. Weekly tasks and season challenges give EXP; levels unlock the free lane. The paid General Certificate opens Prime rewards and +50% task EXP.

  • Login tasks pay 45 points each — pure attendance.
  • Rewards every 100 points from 0 to 8,900, then a Bonus chest.
  • Unclaimed rewards are mailed when the Journey ends.
  • Targets include CC, Armory and Fortification to Lv.20 and Glory 5,000 (600 pts each).

Ancient Dinos · Sunday world boss

Every Sunday at 12:00 AT. One boss lands, the whole server attacks with no attack limit, and rewards are decided by damage before it drops.

WEEK 1 OF 5

T-Rex

Max damage in the window

  • Park your strongest march near the spawn before 12:00. Swing in the first seconds.
  • Fire attack buffs right before spawn, not five minutes early.
  • Damage is cumulative: steady hits from your full roster beat one big rally. Heal and keep sending.
  • Bring Liliana if you have her — built for burst.
  • Can't solo? Join a rally; it still counts for your fossils and rewards.
  • A neglected Biotech Lab caps your damage no matter your troop power.

Titles: read carefully

Each species has a title (Dino Hunter, Horn Sunderer, Wing Breaker…). Only the top 3 damage on the first-ever kill of that species on our server get it. Once a species is killed once, no title again. Chasing a title? Save buffs and your best march for a species 707 hasn't beaten yet. Every other week is a farming week.

Fossil Album & Bio Institute Shop

Sunday bosses fill the album; duplicates turn into eggs; eggs buy power at the weekend shop.

Fossil Album · 20 pieces

Trade Hubs

Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 11:00 AT. The highest-value alliance objective of the season. Ignore them and you hand free diamonds to other alliances.

How they work

  • Hold one and it generates diamond tax envelopes for the whole alliance and unlocks an exclusive shop.
  • Shop is all diamonds: hero fragments, badges, plug-in chests, steel, speedups, power cores — the best diamond-to-power rate in the game.
  • Week 1 is state-only. From week 2, cross-state opens and PvP heats up.
  • Contests repeat, so a lost hub is never lost for good.

Venus capture plan

  • Pre-stage troops before 11:00. Marching after means arriving to a fight.
  • Roles set in advance: rally leaders, reinforcement fillers, one hub manager for access settings.
  • Rotate reinforcements so the hub is never briefly empty — snipes happen in those gaps.

The access-control play

First 30–60 minVenus only — our members shop first
After thatOpen to public — outsiders' spending pays us tax
Cross-state weeksAn open hub taxes enemy-state spending too

A busy hub is a profitable hub. Advertise our open hub in state chat. The most common mistake isn't losing the fight — it's capturing a hub and leaving it locked all session.

14

Clash for Glory & alliance ranking

Alliance vs alliance. On Monday the alliance that picks a rival becomes the attacker; the picked side defends and can't refuse. Glory War fights run Tuesdays.

Rules

  • Two phases: Prep, then Battle.
  • Score Glory Points by destroying the rival's Alliance Centers and season buildings.
  • Winner takes 20% of the loser's Season Points.
  • If Alliance Center I is destroyed, that side loses instantly — defend it.
  • Features: Glory Missile strikes, battle logs, rewards, truce settings.

Pick smart

Attacking is a choice; being picked isn't. A target we can actually beat is worth more than an ego pick. For rally coordination, the same habits from Alliance Duel carry over.

Dino Rescue & the Black Market Guardian

The S3 version of the Yeti system. Intercept armed Predator Squads moving dinosaurs and take the cargo.

Predator Squads

Levels1–200
Mon–Sat2 rewarded kills
Sunday (event)5 rewarded kills
DropsSeason resources, eggs, blueprints, Hero EXP, Pine Cones

Sunday bands

Lv.110–2005 rewarded kills
Lv.310–35010 rewarded kills

Each level respawns many times; the cap is on rewarded kills, not attacks. Spend the 5 on whatever's closest, then put the 10 high-band kills on the highest level you can actually beat — Lv.350 pays far more than Lv.310.

Black Market Guardian (up to Lv.350)

A rally-only target — nobody solos it. Ranking is by damage, but the key mechanic is statewide achievement rewards: as the whole state pushes the boss further, everyone unlocks exclusive equipment fragments, orange hero fragments, recruit tickets, fuel and Dino Feed.

Venus rule: never hold back hits to protect a rank. The statewide thresholds pay more than the ranking spread. Fill rallies and push participation in state chat.

Full in-game event rules
  • During the weekly Black Market Auction, Predator Squads and Guardians actively attack Headquarters.
  • Transporter attacks bypass HQ Guards and damage HQ durability directly.
  • Predator Squad daily reward limit rises to 5 during the event, then returns to 2.
  • Beating a Predator Squad can reveal a Guardian; the final-blow team gets a mailed Discovery Reward.
  • Killing the Guardian pays a Kill Reward and rescues an injured Spinosaurus.
  • Rescue-alliance members send Scouts to treat it; each treatment shortens recovery, up to 10 gifts per event.
  • State Tasks reward the whole state; personal ranking uses total transporter damage.

Dino Egg Defense

The S3 rework of Zombie Siege. Waves of dinos hit every member's HQ. Harder than Zombie Siege: more burst enemies, stronger elites, less forgiveness for a bad troop mix.

Event facts

Who starts itLeader and R4 (once each)

Max dinos at once5
Waves27
Breach penaltyLose 5% of eggs (max 1,000)

How Venus plays it

  • Spend your eggs before it starts. A big bank is a big target.
  • Completion beats ranking — completion rewards are worth much more.
  • Assists count: heal rallies and help neighbours.
  • Multi-kills in one wave pay bonus points; save your best formation for special waves.
  • High personal brackets only open if the alliance total keeps pace — keep everyone online.

Bones & Eggs Boom

A modifier that switches on around mid-season and stays until the end.

Before the Boom

  • Normal Scale and Egg drops
  • Farm eggs steadily for the shop
  • Stockpile eggs before mid-season if saving for a big shop weekend

During the Boom

  • 2× Cretaceous Scales from Raptors and Stego
  • Daily attempts halved; eggs doubled or cut 50% (sources disagree)
  • Best window to spike the Biotech Lab — burn stamina items
Check your own dropsWatch your egg drops in the first 24 hours of the Boom and post what you see in Venus chat so everyone knows which version 707 got. Either way, keep doing your capped Predator Squad kills.

Common mistakes

Every one of these has cost somebody a season.

Do this

  • Virus resistance before combat buildings — always.
  • Capped attempts on Stegosaurus first, Raptors after.
  • Alarm for 11:55 every Sunday for the Ancient Dino.
  • All five Hatch of Legends tasks daily.
  • Bank diamonds before the season for Trade Hubs.
  • Open captured hubs to the public after Venus has shopped.
  • Push max damage on the Black Market Guardian.
  • Enter the Bio Institute Shop with a stockpile and shop patiently.

Avoid this

  • Rushing combat buildings in week one.
  • Burning Raptor attempts before Stego.
  • Logging in late on Sunday.
  • Skipping Hatch dailies because they don't feel urgent.
  • Spending diamonds before Trade Hubs open.
  • Capturing a hub and keeping it locked all session.
  • Holding back on the Guardian to protect a rank.
  • Panic-buying or panic-refreshing in the shop.
  • Treating glory rank as a goal.
20

FAQ

How long is Season 3?
91 days, thirteen weeks — the longest Last Z season so far.
Is Season 3 free-to-play friendly?
Less than Season 2, because Trade Hubs run on diamonds. F2P players should bank diamonds, max Hatch of Legends (the most F2P-friendly system), never miss Sunday fossils, and lean on rallies for high-tier kills.
Which dinosaur should I pick in Hatch of Legends?
Any. T-Rex, Triceratops and Ankylosaurus give the same bonuses; only the skin differs. What matters is doing the five daily tasks.
Can I still get a hero I missed?
Yes. After the six-week release window, hero passes rotate into hero and exclusive-weapon fragments.
What happens to my dino buffs and vehicle skin at season end?
Both are removed. They're season-only — still worth it for 13 weeks of +30% troop attack.
Do we lose city points if we lose the city?
No. Points already earned stay banked.
Why does another guide call this Season 4?
Season numbering differs between servers, and the number matters: caps and bonuses follow your server's season count. On 707 this is Season 3, so specialization stops at Lv.50 and Combat adds a Fortification. Guides written for Season 4 servers list Lv.70 and a 3rd Armory; skip those parts.
My hero names don't match this guide.
Regional names differ: Licia = Yu Chan, Liliana = Queenie, Dodomeki = Amber. Match by faction icon (Blood Rose, Wings of Dawn, Guard of Order).

Sources & known discrepancies

Built for Venus from the LastZ.GG Season 3: Dinosaur Origin guide (written by DXB KING), rewritten in our own words, plus extra notes from LDShop, LootBar and community hero-synergy coverage. Illustrations are original drawings for this page.

  • Bones & Eggs Boom: some sources say eggs are doubled too; the newest says egg drops are cut 50%. Check your own drops.
  • Trade Hub time: most list 11:00 AT; one lists 11:00 PM. Trust the in-game timer.
  • Egg Defense max reward: "14 Golden Wrenches" and "14 Golden Keys" are the same item, translated differently.
  • Level Swap refunds: one summary says excess skill books are refunded; the in-game rules say they are not. Assume no refund.
  • Dodomeki skill data is single-sourced; treat as provisional.
  • Specialization cap and Combat bonus: LastZ.GG and LDShop list a Lv.70 cap and a 3rd Armory, which applies where Dinosaur Origin is Season 4. On 707 it is Season 3: the cap is Lv.50 and Combat adds a Fortification, as confirmed by experienced 707 players.
  • Season 2 equivalents: Snowballs match Pet Feed and Snowflakes match Cretaceous Scales, as confirmed by experienced 707 players.
